instruction.name: xvftintrml.l.s
instruction.description: Convert single-precision floating point elements in lower part of every 128-bit vector of `a` to signed 64-bit integer, rounding towards negative infinity.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 5.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvftintrml.l.s $xr0, $xr8; xvftintrml.l.s $xr1, $xr9; xvftintrml.l.s $xr2, $xr10; xvftintrml.l.s $xr3, $xr11; xvftintrml.l.s $xr4, $xr12; xvftintrml.l.s $xr5, $xr13; xvftintrml.l.s $xr6, $xr14; xvftintrml.l.s $xr7, $xr15
